# Directory Submissions Skill for Muse

Runs the directory layer of a product launch as a compounding backlink and discovery foundation: three hard rules first (never submit before the landing page is live and indexed with pricing, privacy/terms, assets, and a demo video; build destination pages — competitor-alternative pages, use-case pages, template galleries — before chasing directories; vary positioning per directory type instead of copy-pasting), then a tiered submission catalog from the Product Hunt anchor launch through startup/SaaS directories, AI directories, agent/MCP registries, no-code directories, review sites, and niche verticals, with a submission tracker. It includes a full Product Hunt deep dive (3-week prep timeline, launch-day execution where comment quality outranks upvote count, post-launch recap), a G2/Capterra 10-in-30 review protocol, and GEO tactics so landing pages get cited by AI engines (single H1, FAQ schema, comparison tables, original research). Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: directories alone won't generate meaningful leads — they're the foundation, not the strategy; several tactics are time-stamped (G2 2026 report cutoffs, Product Hunt algorithm claims) and may drift, so treat dates as of the skill's writing; and the Phase-0 readiness checklist is real work — a "no" on core items blocks submission until the asset exists. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
